characters.description: Character IDs (from characters_plan) appearing in this shot. PRIMARY SUBJECT FIRST. The runner uploads these to Qwen Edit's reference slots in this order — slot 1 binds tightest. Max 2 (Qwen Edit Multi-Angle constraint). Empty array IS allowed (e.g. an insert shot of an object); the runner falls back to the base shot. Use the snake_case id verbatim from characters_plan — e.g. "pawn_shop_owner", not "the owner".

chosenBaseShotNumber.description: Of the previousN prior shots provided, pick the one whose framing best supports THIS shot's composition. Null if this is shot 1 (no prior) or no prior is suitable.

chosenBaseReason.description: One sentence: why this prior shot is the best chain base (e.g. 'shot 2 had both characters in medium two-shot, ideal for tightening to a CU on Ruby').

view.description: Camera azimuth. back-right quarter view = OTS over right shoulder.

elevation.description: Camera vertical angle. Default eye-level shot.

deltaText.description: Natural-language description of what CHANGES from the chosen prior shot to this one — new actions, character entries, expression changes, camera motion. Do not restate things that haven't changed. Do not add the <sks> prefix; the runner assembles it.
